```{r}
# ---- Unjournal brand palette ----------------------------------------------
UJ_ORANGE <- "#f19e4b"   # LLM
UJ_GREEN  <- "#99bb66"   # Human

theme_uj <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# ---- small helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
fix_bounds <- function(df, lo, hi) {
  lo2 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[lo]]))
  hi2 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[hi]]))
  swap <- !is.na(lo2) & !is.na(hi2) & (lo2 > hi2)
  df[swap, c(lo, hi)] <- df[swap, c(hi, lo)]
  df
}

safe_min <- function(ci, pts) {
  if (length(ci) == 0 || all(is.na(ci))) suppressWarnings(min(pts, na.rm = TRUE)) else suppressWarnings(min(ci, na.rm = TRUE))
}
safe_max <- function(ci, pts) {
  if (length(ci) == 0 || all(is.na(ci))) suppressWarnings(max(pts, na.rm = TRUE)) else suppressWarnings(max(ci, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Quantile/equal binning shared by both raters (for κ)
bin_together <- function(a, b, n_bins = 5, strategy = c("quantile","equal")) {
  strategy <- match.arg(strategy)
  x <- c(a, b)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  # discrete-ish fallback
  if (length(unique(x)) <= max(3, n_bins)) {
    u <- sort(unique(x))
    f <- function(v) match(v, u) - 1L
    return(list(a_bin = f(a), b_bin = f(b), k = length(u)))
  }
  if (strategy == "quantile") {
    qs <- unique(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1), na.rm = TRUE))
    if (length(qs) - 1L < 2L) {
      strategy <- "equal"
    } else {
      edges <- qs
    }
  }
  if (strategy == "equal") {
    lo <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE); hi <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    edges <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  }
  # widen to include endpoints robustly
  edges[1] <- edges[1] - 1e-9
  edges[length(edges)] <- edges[length(edges)] + 1e-9
  a_bin <- cut(a, breaks = edges, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE) - 1L
  b_bin <- cut(b, breaks = edges, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE) - 1L
  k <- max(c(a_bin, b_bin), na.rm = TRUE) + 1L
  list(a_bin = a_bin, b_bin = b_bin, k = k)
}

# Cohen κ (unweighted, linear, quadratic) for labels 0..k-1
weighted_kappa <- function(a_bin, b_bin, k = NULL, weights = c("quadratic","linear","unweighted")) {
  weights <- match.arg(weights)
  a <- as.integer(a_bin); b <- as.integer(b_bin)
  keep <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
  a <- a[keep]; b <- b[keep]
  if (!length(a)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.null(k)) k <- max(c(a,b)) + 1L

  M <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = k)
  for (i in seq_along(a)) M[a[i]+1L, b[i]+1L] <- M[a[i]+1L, b[i]+1L] + 1
  if (sum(M) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  M <- M / sum(M)
  r <- rowSums(M); csum <- colSums(M)
  E <- r %*% t(csum)

  I <- matrix(rep(0:(k-1), times = k), nrow = k)
  J <- t(I)
  if (weights == "quadratic") {
    W <- ((I - J)^2) / ((k - 1)^2)
  } else if (weights == "linear") {
    W <- abs(I - J) / (k - 1)
  } else {
    W <- 1 - diag(1, k)  # 1 off-diagonal, 0 on diagonal
  }
  num <- sum(W * M); den <- sum(W * E)
  if (den == 0) NA_real_ else 1 - num/den
}
```

On this page we present preliminray results, starting with a comparison of the LLM‑generated ratings (`r print(currentmodel)`, see the[(previous section](methods.qmd)) with human evaluations across [the Unjournal's criteria](https://globalimpact.gitbook.io/the-unjournal-project-and-communication-space/policies-projects-evaluation-workflow/evaluation/guidelines-for-evaluators#undefined-1). 



```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Mapping paper keys - short titles
UJmap <- read_delim(here("data", "UJ_map.csv"), delim = ";") |>
  mutate(label_paper_title = research,
         label_paper = paper) |>
  select(c("label_paper_title", "label_paper"))



# LLM generated ratings
metrics <- read_csv(here("data", "metrics_long.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

metrics <- metrics |> clean_names() |>
  mutate(evaluator = "GPT-5",
         label_paper = paper,
         middle_rating = midpoint,
         lower_ci = lower_bound,
         upper_ci = upper_bound,
         criteria = metric) |>
  mutate(criteria = if_else(criteria == "advancing_knowledge", "adv_knowledge", criteria)) |>
  mutate(criteria = if_else(criteria == "open_science", "open_sci", criteria)) |>
  mutate(criteria = if_else(criteria == "logic_communication", "logic_comms", criteria)) |>
  mutate(criteria = if_else(criteria == "global_relevance", "gp_relevance", criteria)) |>
  mutate(criteria = if_else(criteria == "claims_evidence", "claims", criteria)) |>
  # mutate(criteria = factor(criteria)) |>
  left_join(UJmap, by = c("label_paper")) |>
  select(c("label_paper", "label_paper_title", "evaluator", "criteria", "middle_rating", "lower_ci", "upper_ci", "rationale"))
  
  
# Unjournal ratings
rsx <- read_csv(here("data", "rsx_evalr_rating.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  clean_names()  |>
  mutate(label_paper_title = research) |>
  select(-c("research"))

# More on evaluated research
research <- read_csv(here("data", "research.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(status == "50_published evaluations (on PubPub, by Unjournal)")

# rsx_collapsed = rsx |>

# More journal rating info

# jql70_raw <- if (!is.na(jql70_file)) read_clean(jql70_file) else NULL
  

# Merge Unjournal data and keys
rsx_research <- rsx  |>
  left_join(UJmap, by = c("label_paper_title")) |>
  left_join(research, by = c("label_paper_title")) |>  
  select(c("label_paper", "label_paper_title", "evaluator","criteria","middle_rating","lower_ci","upper_ci")) |>
  mutate(rationale = "")
 
# Merge Unjournal data and LLM metrics
all_ratings <- rbind(rsx_research, metrics) |>
  mutate(criteria = factor(criteria)) |>
  mutate(evaluator = factor(evaluator)) |>
  mutate(label_paper_title = factor(label_paper_title)) |>
  mutate(label_paper = factor(label_paper))

# clean up
rm("metrics", "research", "rsx", "rsx_research", "UJmap")

# write_csv(all_ratings, here("data", "all_ratings.csv"))
write_rds(
  all_ratings,
  here("data", "all_ratings.rds"),
  compress = "none"
  )


# Ensure numeric + fix any swapped CI bounds
all_ratings <- all_ratings |>
  mutate(across(c(middle_rating, lower_ci, upper_ci), as.numeric)) |>
  fix_bounds("lower_ci","upper_ci")

# Split: LLM vs Human raters (LLM = evaluator == 'GPT-5')
human_raw <- all_ratings |>
  filter(evaluator != "GPT-5") |>
  filter(!is.na(middle_rating))

llm_raw <- all_ratings |>
  filter(evaluator == "GPT-5") |>
  transmute(
    label_paper, label_paper_title, criteria,
    midpoint_llm = middle_rating,
    lower_llm = lower_ci,
    upper_llm = upper_ci
  ) |>
  distinct()
 




human_use <- human_raw |>
  group_by(label_paper, label_paper_title, criteria) |>
  summarise(
    midpoint_human   = mean(middle_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    # keep means of human CIs (used in one of the outlier tables)
    lower_human      = mean(lower_ci, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper_human      = mean(upper_ci, na.rm = TRUE),
    # CI union (fallback to min/max of points where CI missing)
    human_lo_union   = safe_min(lower_ci, middle_rating),
    human_hi_union   = safe_max(upper_ci, middle_rating),
    n_raters         = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  fix_bounds("human_lo_union","human_hi_union")

# Merge to LLM
merged <- llm_raw |>
  inner_join(human_use, by = c("label_paper","label_paper_title","criteria")) |>
  mutate(diff = midpoint_llm - midpoint_human)

# Long form for distributions
ratings_long <- merged |>
  select(label_paper, label_paper_title, criteria, midpoint_llm, midpoint_human) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("midpoint_"),
               names_to = "rater", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(rater = recode(rater,
                        midpoint_llm   = "LLM",
                        midpoint_human = "Human"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rankslope
#| fig-cap: "Relative ranking (overall) by LLM and Human evaluators"
#| fig-height: 8



make_s_bezier <- function(D, dx_base = 0.33, dx_min = 0.08) {
  # adaptive horizontal control distance based on |Δrank|
  dy <- abs(D$pos_right - D$pos_left)
  k  <- max(2, stats::quantile(dy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))  # scale
  dx_i <- pmax(dx_min, dx_base * exp(-dy / k))

  pieces <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(D)), function(i) {
    y0 <- D$pos_left[i]; y1 <- D$pos_right[i]
    dx <- dx_i[i]
    tibble::tibble(
      group = i,
      x = c(0, dx, 1 - dx, 1),
      y = c(y0, y0, y1, y1),
      col = dplyr::case_when(
        D$delta[i] >  0 ~ "LLM higher",
        D$delta[i] <  0 ~ "LLM lower",
        TRUE            ~ "Tie"
      )
    )
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(pieces)
}


# --- replace build_rank_positions ------------------------------------------
build_rank_positions <- function(metric) {
  D <- merged |>
    filter(criteria == metric) |>
    # keep BOTH labels; create a display label preferring the short code
    mutate(
      label_use = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(label_paper) & nzchar(as.character(label_paper)),
        as.character(label_paper),
        as.character(label_paper_title)
      )
    ) |>
    select(label_use, label_paper, label_paper_title, midpoint_human, midpoint_llm)

  if (!nrow(D)) return(NULL)

  left  <- D |> arrange(desc(midpoint_human), label_use) |> mutate(pos_left  = row_number())
  right <- D |> arrange(desc(midpoint_llm),   label_use) |> mutate(pos_right = row_number())

  D |> 
    left_join(left  |> select(label_use, pos_left),  by = "label_use") |>
    left_join(right |> select(label_use, pos_right), by = "label_use") |>
    mutate(delta = midpoint_llm - midpoint_human)
}

# --- replace plot_rank_slope_S (only the labeling bits changed) ------------
plot_rank_slope_S <- function(metric, D = NULL) {
  if (is.null(D)) D <- build_rank_positions(metric)
  if (is.null(D) || !nrow(D)) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  B <- make_s_bezier(D)

  ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_bezier(
      data = B,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = group, colour = col),
      size = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(data = D, aes(x = 0, y = pos_left),
               color = UJ_GREEN, size = 2.2) +
    geom_point(data = D, aes(x = 1, y = pos_right),
               color = UJ_ORANGE, shape = 18, size = 2.4) +
    # LEFT labels: use label_use (label_paper if present, else title)
    geom_text(data = D, aes(x = 0, y = pos_left, label = label_use),
              hjust = 1.05, size = 3, color = "grey20") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("LLM higher" = UJ_ORANGE,
                                  "LLM lower"  = UJ_GREEN,
                                  "Tie"        = "grey55"),
                       name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.7, 1.02),
                       breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("Human", "LLM"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Rank slopegraph (S-curves) — ",
                     stringr::str_to_title(gsub("_"," ", metric))),
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_uj() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 30, b = 10, l = 140))
}

# Example:
plot_rank_slope_S(metric_name)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-agreement
#| tbl-cap: "Overall agreement across all metrics"

agreement_summary <- function(df, n_bins = 5, bin_strategy = "quantile") {
  df |>
    group_by(criteria) |>
    summarise(
      n           = sum(is.finite(midpoint_llm) & is.finite(midpoint_human)),
      pearson     = suppressWarnings(cor(midpoint_llm, midpoint_human, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")),
      spearman    = suppressWarnings(cor(midpoint_llm, midpoint_human, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")),
      mean_bias   = mean(midpoint_llm - midpoint_human, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_bias = median(midpoint_llm - midpoint_human, na.rm = TRUE),
      kappa_unwtd = {
        bins <- bin_together(midpoint_llm, midpoint_human, n_bins = n_bins, strategy = bin_strategy)
        weighted_kappa(bins$a_bin, bins$b_bin, k = bins$k, weights = "unweighted")
      },
      kappa_quad  = {
        bins <- bin_together(midpoint_llm, midpoint_human, n_bins = n_bins, strategy = bin_strategy)
        weighted_kappa(bins$a_bin, bins$b_bin, k = bins$k, weights = "quadratic")
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(criteria)
}

agree_view <- agreement_summary(merged, n_bins = 5, bin_strategy = "quantile") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

kable(agree_view, caption = "Agreement by metric (Pearson, Spearman, mean/median bias, κ unweighted/weighted)")

overall_stats <- function(df, n_bins = 5, bin_strategy = "quantile") {
  llm <- df$midpoint_llm; hum <- df$midpoint_human
  pr  <- suppressWarnings(cor(llm, hum, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"))
  mad <- mean(abs(llm - hum), na.rm = TRUE)
  bins <- bin_together(llm, hum, n_bins = n_bins, strategy = bin_strategy)
  tibble(
    n = sum(is.finite(llm) & is.finite(hum)),
    pearson = pr,
    mad = mad,
    kappa_unwtd = weighted_kappa(bins$a_bin, bins$b_bin, k = bins$k, weights = "unweighted"),
    kappa_quad  = weighted_kappa(bins$a_bin, bins$b_bin, k = bins$k, weights = "quadratic")
  )
}

kable(overall_stats(merged) |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-coverage
#| tbl-cap: "CI coverage using Human CI = union across raters"

calibrate_per_metric <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(criteria) |>
    summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      slope = {
        fit <- tryCatch(lm(midpoint_human ~ midpoint_llm, data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else unname(coef(fit)[2])
      },
      intercept = {
        fit <- tryCatch(lm(midpoint_human ~ midpoint_llm, data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else unname(coef(fit)[1])
      },
      r2 = {
        fit <- tryCatch(lm(midpoint_human ~ midpoint_llm, data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else summary(fit)$r.squared
      },
      MAD_pre = mean(abs(midpoint_llm - midpoint_human), na.rm = TRUE),
      MAD_post = {
        fit <- tryCatch(lm(midpoint_human ~ midpoint_llm, data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else {
          yhat <- predict(fit, newdata = cur_data())
          mean(abs(yhat - midpoint_human), na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      },
      MAD_delta = MAD_pre - MAD_post,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

kable(calibrate_per_metric(merged) |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))),
      caption = "Calibration: Human ≈ intercept + slope·LLM (per metric)")

# Coverage: does each side's CI cover the other's midpoint?
coverage_tbl <- merged |>
  filter(is.finite(lower_llm), is.finite(upper_llm),
         is.finite(human_lo_union), is.finite(human_hi_union)) |>
  mutate(
    human_in_llm = midpoint_human >= lower_llm & midpoint_human <= upper_llm,
    llm_in_human = midpoint_llm   >= human_lo_union & midpoint_llm   <= human_hi_union,
    both_cover   = human_in_llm & llm_in_human
  ) |>
  group_by(criteria) |>
  summarise(
    N = dplyr::n(),
    human_in_llm = round(mean(human_in_llm), 2),
    llm_in_human = round(mean(llm_in_human), 2),
    both_cover   = round(mean(both_cover), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(coverage_tbl)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| eval: false

# global axis limits (square)
global_min <- min(c(merged$human_lo_union, merged$lower_llm,
                    merged$midpoint_human, merged$midpoint_llm), na.rm = TRUE)
global_max <- max(c(merged$human_hi_union, merged$upper_llm,
                    merged$midpoint_human, merged$midpoint_llm), na.rm = TRUE)
pad <- 0.05 * (global_max - global_min)
lims <- c(global_min - pad, global_max + pad)

plot_ellipses <- function(metric) {
  J <- merged |>
    filter(criteria == metric) |>
    mutate(
      cx = midpoint_human,
      cy = midpoint_llm,
      rx = pmax(cx - human_lo_union, human_hi_union - cx, 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      ry = pmax((upper_llm - lower_llm)/2, 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  # Individual human points at y = LLM midpoint
  Hpts <- human_raw |>
    filter(criteria == metric) |>
    select(label_paper, label_paper_title, human_x = middle_rating) |>
    inner_join(J |> select(label_paper, cy), by = "label_paper") |>
    rename(llm_y = cy)

  r_p <- suppressWarnings(cor(J$midpoint_human, J$midpoint_llm, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"))
  r_s <- suppressWarnings(cor(J$midpoint_human, J$midpoint_llm, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"))
  annot <- sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f; Spearman \u03C1 = %.2f", r_p, r_s)

  ggplot() +
    ggforce::geom_ellipse(
      data = J,
      aes(x0 = cx, y0 = cy, a = rx, b = ry, angle = 0),
      color = alpha(UJ_GREEN, 0.65),
      fill  = alpha(UJ_GREEN, 0.15),
      size = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(data = Hpts, aes(x = human_x, y = llm_y),
               color = UJ_GREEN, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_point(data = J, aes(x = midpoint_human, y = midpoint_llm),
               color = UJ_ORANGE, shape = 18, size = 2.6) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
    coord_equal(xlim = lims, ylim = lims, expand = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("LLM vs Human — CI ellipses — ",
                     str_to_title(gsub("_"," ", metric))),
      x = "Human (x)", y = "LLM (y)",
      caption = annot
    ) +
    theme_uj()
}
```
